runner_contract.fixture_resolution: extends deep-merge patch; references $fixture.field and $result.field resolved without eval; hashes computed over defined canonical UTF-8 JSON or original bytes as specified
runner_contract.operation_binding: tests/acceptance/operation_map.json maps these scenario aliases to actual OpenAPI operationId/internal/browser driver; binding is mandatory reviewed artifact
runner_contract.result_projection: Deterministic extraction from real HTTP/DB/bytes/network/trace, never self-reported by LLM
runner_contract.job_protocol: POST async task must be 202 with job_id then poll GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}; success requires committed terminal state
runner_contract.isolation: per-case temporary DB and synthetic fixture; freeze UTC clock and seed; no live provider or .env access
runner_contract.money_precision: DB signed integer fen; API money_minor integer decimal string; price/ratio/dividend Decimal strings; shares integer
runner_contract.test_id_vs_case_id: test_id identifies acceptance test; case_id inside fixture identifies product Case
runner_contract.status_policy: not_run until implementation executes; not_implemented/blocked/fail/pass are distinct and skipped is not pass
runner_contract.session_context_security: Replay mode/replay_id/cutoff are bound by authenticated server SessionContext; optional replay header is a consistency assertion, never source of authorization; no session=401; replay/training session on legacy routes=403.

fixture_schema_requirements.unknown_available_at_policy: exclude clean replay or shift conservatively to next usable session with explicit evidence/versioned policy; never use report quarter-end or invent midnight
fixture_schema_requirements.fixture_source_notice: all quote/instrument/calendar/fee examples synthetic; no claim about current market or complete legal rules
server_context_rules: session authentication required before data routing
unsafe requests require session-bound CSRF token and trusted Origin
optional X-Replay header omission cannot remove bound cutoff
replay_id and cutoff authorized by server context, not client header/body/query
replay or training context cannot read legacy current/future data routes
